title: Under a sink (kitchen or bathroom cabinet)

parts.label: P-trap
parts.looks: The U-shaped bend of drain pipe (white plastic, chrome or black) under the sink, with slip nuts at each end.
parts.normal: Dry nuts and pipe, no water on the cabinet floor below.
parts.abnormal: Drops hanging from a nut or the bend, a wet or stained cabinet floor directly under it.

parts.label: Drain pipe
parts.looks: The tailpiece from the sink basket down to the trap, and the arm from the trap into the wall.
parts.abnormal: Water marks or drips at a joint.

parts.label: Supply lines
parts.looks: Thin braided or plastic hoses from the shut-off valves up to the faucet.
parts.abnormal: Kinks, bulges, rust on the braid, drips at the nut.

parts.label: Shut-off valves
parts.looks: One or two small valves with oval or round handles where the pipes come out of the wall or floor.
parts.abnormal: Green or white crust, drips at the stem, a missing handle.

parts.label: Garbage disposal
parts.looks: A round metal or plastic canister hanging under the sink drain, with a power cord or wiring.
parts.abnormal: Water dripping from the bottom or the side connection.

parts.label: Cabinet floor
parts.looks: The base panel of the cabinet.
parts.abnormal: Swollen, warped or dark stained board, standing water.

parts.label: Debris or stored items
parts.abnormal: Only mention when it hides the pipes; ask the caller to move it.

parts.label: Corrosion
parts.looks: Green or white crust on valves and nuts, rust on metal pipe.
parts.abnormal: A sign of a past or slow leak, not proof of a current one.

faults.name: Trap or drain leak
faults.evidence: Water drops on the trap or a joint, or a wet stain directly beneath it. Ask to run water for 10 seconds while the camera watches the joint.

faults.name: Supply line or valve leak
faults.evidence: Drops or crust at the valve stem or the line's nut.

faults.name: Disposal leak
faults.evidence: Water on the bottom or side of the disposal body.

hazards.label: Water on the disposal wiring or an outlet
hazards.threshold: Water visibly on or dripping onto a plugged-in cord, outlet or the disposal's wiring cover.

may: Clear the stored items out of the cabinet.
Turn the shut-off valves clockwise to stop a leak (water only).
Put a bowl and towel under a drip.
Use a phone flashlight or the Light button.
must_not: Put a hand into the disposal.
Unplug or touch a wet cord or outlet.

tour.open: Let's look under the sink together. Open both doors and show me the whole cabinet from about an arm's length.

checkpoints.hint: Tilt down to the U-shaped bend in the drain pipe.
Look at the back wall or floor of the cabinet for the small valves with handles.
Follow the thin hoses from the valves up toward the faucet.
Tilt down to the floor of the cabinet so I can see if it is wet or stained.
